skill_name: Explain what a GPT model is and what it offers.
workflow: GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer) is a language modeling algorithm based on Transformer architecture that has achieved immense success in many NLP tasks such as question-answering and text summarization. GPT models learn the likelihood distribution of a language by using a large amounts of data, pre-trained models, and transformer networks.
